The '''Malal Mountains''' were a [[Mountain/Legends|mountainous]] region on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]]. [[Bela Vistal/Legends|Bela Vistal]] was nestled within this mountain range.<ref name="SWG" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Malal Mountains are one of many designated planetary regions in the [[Wikipedia:MMORPG|MMORPG]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]''.<ref name="SWG" />
